LNG_OUTBREAK_FIELD_LABEL_ALLOW_CASE_NOTI.translation: Allow notify team when creating cases
Shows the 'notify team' option on the case creation form for this outbreak, triggered as soon as the case is created

LNG_OUTBREAK_FIELD_LABEL_ALLOW_CONTACT_N.translation: Allow notify team when creating contacts
Shows the 'notify team' option on the contact creation form for this outbreak, triggered as soon as the contact is created
